user_input: Refactor the existing full-stack project in the workspace per the user's request. Start by inspecting the entire relevant frontend/backend folder structures and project manifests/configs, understand current routes, API contracts, auth, persistence, and business behavior, and form a concrete refactoring plan before editing. Then implement the refactor systematically while preserving behavior. Frontend React component files must each be fewer than 100 lines. Keep changes surgical, update related docs if appropriate, and do not commit. Run the smallest relevant frontend/backend validation commands available and report outcomes/limitations. Finish with the updated frontend/backend folder structures, key changes, any file splits/reorganizations, API compatibility, test/build status, and remaining attention items. Bound the work to this repository; if the full requested refactor is too large to safely complete, implement a coherent module-sized slice and explicitly state unfinished areas and next steps rather than claiming completion.
title: CodeCollab Full-Stack Refactor

assessment_snapshot.intro: The workspace contains a React/Vite client, a Spring Boot REST/MongoDB service, and a separate Node.js/Socket.IO collaboration server:
bullets: The React client is on React 18.3.1 with React Router 7.17; routes cover home, login/signup, create/join/available rooms, room editing, and dashboard. Custom CSS is used; RSuite is declared but no source imports were found.

The Spring Boot 4.1.0 / Java 17 service exposes user login/signup/profile, dashboard stats, and room create/join/list/detail/content REST flows; MongoDB persists user and room data. The Node socket server listens separately and relays room presence, editor changes/restores, and chat.

The client stores an auth token/user and recent-room/editor state in localStorage; the socket server tracks connected participants in memory. No UI screenshots or design-system reference were provided. The root package has a build script but no test script; a Maven test source exists.

proposed_outcome: Perform a surgical, in-place modular refactor of the existing React/Vite frontend, Spring Boot/MongoDB REST backend, and Node.js/Socket.IO server. Keep current routes, REST/socket contracts, persistence and user-visible behavior compatible; keep every frontend React component file below 100 lines, validate with the smallest available checks, document remaining work, and do not commit.
